title: Bias is a Math Problem, AI Bias is a Technical Problem: 10-year Literature Review of AI/LLM Bias Research Reveals Narrow [Gender-Centric] Conceptions of “Bias”, and Academia-Industry Gap

bias_targets.methodology: Systematic literature review analyzing the frequency and scope of gender bias studies in 189 AI/LLM papers, noting its significant overrepresentation (79.9% of the corpus) and predominant focus on binary gender and occupational associations.
Systematic literature review quantifying the prevalence and conceptualization of race/ethnicity bias research across 189 recently published AI/LLM fairness papers.
Systematic literature review measuring the representation of age bias research within a corpus of 189 AI/LLM fairness papers.

Systematic literature review measuring the representation of nationality bias research within a corpus of 189 AI/LLM fairness papers.
